title: Continuation of Services Terms by Appeals and Grievances Case Type
content:
Under **Appeals and Grievances**, previously authorized services may continue while some case types are pending. The terms sheet sets, per case type, whether continuation is available, the request period, what continues, whether the plan may recover the cost of continued services when the decision is upheld, the balance at or below which nothing is recovered, and whether recovery is waived for a member who states financial hardship.

## Terms by case type

| Case type | Continuation available | Request period (calendar days after the notice date, or before the action's effective date if later) | What continues | Recovery of continued-service cost when upheld | Nothing recovered at or below (USD) | Recovery waived on a statement of financial hardship |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Member Grievance | No | 0 (not available) | Not applicable | Not allowed | 0.00 | No |
| Quality of Care Grievance | No | 0 (not available) | Not applicable | Not allowed | 0.00 | No |
| Standard Appeal | Yes | 10 | Previously authorized units only | Allowed | 25.00 | Yes |
| Expedited Appeal | Yes | 10 | Previously authorized units only | Allowed | 25.00 | Yes |
| State Fair Hearing | Yes | 10 | Previously authorized units only | Allowed | 25.00 | Yes |
| External Medical Review | No | 0 (not available) | Not applicable | Not allowed | 0.00 | No |

## Reading the sheet

- Continuation is offered on three case types only: Standard Appeal, Expedited Appeal and State Fair Hearing. On each of them the request period is 10 calendar days, only the previously authorized units continue, recovery is allowed, the recovery floor is 25.00 USD and a statement of financial hardship waives recovery.
- Member Grievance, Quality of Care Grievance and External Medical Review carry no continuation: the request period shows 0, nothing continues, recovery is not allowed and the floor and hardship columns have no application.
